notes: Cruising a city is stated as the whole game, with no deliveries, races or chases, so there is no lap and no finish and this is Simulation on Vehicle Sim rather than Racing. The preset's world-open shape stands as the shared city everyone drives around, sized by the answer at a few connected blocks, which keeps it one continuous surface rather than separate zones. path-road-vehicle carries the road network and settlement-density the modern real-world blocks it runs between, with the streetlights and traffic details as dressing on those roads; resource-shared was dropped as nothing is extracted. Decided without a user: models from the Roblox store are asset sourcing rather than layout, free cruising means nothing terminal is placed, and no interiors were asked for so the build stays on P0.
